brief: Selling AI prompts and prompt packs as products. Pricing, packaging, where to sell, what actually moves units in 2026.

slots.author: Maya Ortiz
slots.headline: Sell AI Prompts Like Products in 2026
slots.body: Prompts are the new digital products. Here's how to price, package, and sell them for real revenue in 2026.

slots.author: Maya Ortiz
slots.title: Price by Outcome, Not Words
slots.body: Stop charging $5 for 50 prompts. Bundle by use case and charge $27-$97 for transformation, not text files.

slots.author: Maya Ortiz
slots.title: Package Prompts as Systems
slots.body: Sell templates, SOPs, and prompt chains together. Buyers pay for workflow speed, not isolated chat inputs.

slots.author: Maya Ortiz
slots.title: Sell Where Buyers Already Are
slots.body: Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and X DMs convert best. Avoid crowded marketplaces that bury your listings.

slots.author: Maya Ortiz
slots.title: Lead With the Aha Moment
slots.body: Show the before-and-after output in your preview. Proof beats promises when selling invisible tools.

slots.author: Maya Ortiz
slots.title: Niche Down to Scale Up
slots.body: Generic prompt packs are commodities now. Win in 2026 by solving one painful job-to-be-done.

slots.author: Maya Ortiz
slots.title: Own Your Audience First
slots.body: Collect emails before you launch. One warm list will outsell a hundred cold impressions every time.

slots.author: Maya Ortiz
slots.headline: Ready to Monetize Your Prompts?
slots.body: Drop a 🚀 if you're building your first prompt product this month.
